Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph and choose the correct order.

A. Best of all, it costs nothing and needs no special equipment.
B. A brisk morning walk is one of the simplest forms of exercise.
C. It is also a good way to meet neighbours and make friends.
D. Besides burning calories, it wakes up the body and clears the mind.
E. Over time, these small habits improve both physical and mental health.
The paragraph opens with the general claim about morning walks, adds benefits in a logical sequence, and closes with the long-term effect of 'these small habits'.

Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph and choose the correct order.

A. Reading is a habit that rewards those who practise it regularly.
B. Parents should therefore encourage children to read from an early age.
C. Even a few pages a day can make a noticeable difference.
D. Unlike scrolling on a phone, it demands patience and attention.
E. It introduces them to new ideas and improves their vocabulary.
Reading is introduced first, its benefits follow, then the contrast with phone scrolling, the reassurance about small daily effort, and finally the recommendation to parents.

Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph and choose the correct order.

A. With a smartphone, a customer can pay bills in seconds.
B. However, users must protect their passwords and check every transaction.
C. Online payment has transformed the way people shop.
D. Convenience, in short, should never come at the cost of safety.
E. This saves time and reduces the need to carry cash.
The topic sentence introduces online payment, an example follows, 'This saves time' refers back to paying in seconds, 'However' introduces the caution, and the final sentence concludes.

Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph and choose the correct order.

A. Yet thousands of trees are cut every year for roads and buildings.
B. For these reasons, every city should protect its green cover.
C. Planting trees is one of the cheapest ways to fight climate change.
D. The loss is felt most sharply in crowded neighbourhoods.
E. They provide shade, absorb carbon dioxide and support wildlife.
The opening claim is supported by benefits, 'Yet' marks the contrast with tree felling, the consequence follows, and 'For these reasons' closes with a recommendation.

Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph and choose the correct order.

A. A simple timetable, therefore, is the best defence against panic.
B. Students often make the mistake of studying only before an exam.
C. Spacing the same material over several days helps the brain retain it.
D. This habit increases stress and rarely produces lasting learning.
E. Regular revision is far more effective than last-minute cramming.
The mistake is described first, 'This habit' points back to it, the contrast with regular revision follows, the explanation comes next, and the conclusion recommends a timetable.

Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph and choose the correct order.

A. Social media spreads news faster than any other medium.
B. But speed often comes at the cost of accuracy.
C. A newspaper, on the other hand, offers edited and verified information.
D. Readers must therefore decide which source deserves their trust.
E. Both have a place, yet they serve different purposes.
Social media is introduced first, its drawback follows, 'on the other hand' introduces the newspaper, 'Both' sums up the comparison, and 'therefore' draws the conclusion for readers.

Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph and choose the correct order.

A. Processed food, by contrast, should be eaten sparingly.
B. A balanced diet supplies the body with essential nutrients.
C. No single food can provide everything a person needs.
D. Fresh fruits, vegetables and whole grains should form the base.
E. This is why variety matters more than quantity.
The general principle comes first, the reason follows, 'This is why' links to the need for variety, and the final two sentences give specific examples with a contrast.

Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph and choose the correct order.

A. A short list of priorities helps focus on what truly matters.
B. At the end of the day, they wonder where the time went.
C. Good time management, therefore, begins with a simple list.
D. People often lose hours to small, unplanned tasks.
E. Planning the day in advance prevents this waste.
The problem is stated first, its consequence follows, the solution comes next, the method is explained, and the conclusion returns to the simple list.

Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph and choose the correct order.

B. Meeting people from different backgrounds challenges assumptions.
C. Travelling exposes people to unfamiliar customs and languages.
D. It is often said that travel is the best education.
E. Such experiences build tolerance and confidence.
The familiar saying opens the paragraph, the explanation follows, a further example is added, 'Such experiences' summarises their effect, and the final sentence draws a conclusion.

Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph and choose the correct order.

Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph and choose the correct order.

Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph and choose the correct order.

Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph and choose the correct order.

Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph and choose the correct order.

Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph and choose the correct order.

Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph and choose the correct order.

Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph and choose the correct order.

Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph and choose the correct order.

Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph and choose the correct order.

Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph and choose the correct order.

Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph and choose the correct order.

Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph and choose the correct order.

Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph and choose the correct order.

Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph and choose the correct order.

Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph and choose the correct order.

Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph and choose the correct order.

Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph and choose the correct order.
